patterns.message: Cross-directory imports use the @/ alias, not relative ../ paths (AGENTS.md: Import Alias).
Never import @legendapp/list directly - go through the components/List wrapper (AGENTS.md: Long Lists).
Never import pressto directly - go through @/components/presstable (adds press debouncing + the withUniwind className wrapper).
Import Sheet/SheetProvider from @/components/sheet — the native lib has no web build; the wrapper provides the Modal fallback via index.web.tsx.
Import { haptics } from @/lib/haptics — pulsar has no web implementation; the wrapper no-ops on web via index.web.ts.
Use @expo/ui/community/datetime-picker instead — drop-in replacement powered by SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose, no config plugin needed.
@expo/vector-icons is deprecated by Expo — import from @react-native-vector-icons/<set>/static instead (e.g. @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons/static).
Import ZoomableImage from @/components/zoomable-image — the wrapper pairs galeria with the withUniwind Image and handles the empty-uri fallback.
Import MorphText from @/components/morph-text — torph is DOM-only; the wrapper falls back to a plain Text on native via index.tsx.
Import { cn } from @/lib/cn — the wrapper is the one swap point for the class-name composer (AGENTS.md: Class Names).

Do not adopt effect-rx. TanStack Query owns caching/invalidation/React state; Effect stays contained in lib/providers + lib/http and runs at the boundary via Effect.runPromise (AGENTS.md: Tech Stack → Effect).

paths.name: react-native
paths.message: Use the components/List wrapper (Legend List), never raw FlatList (AGENTS.md: Long Lists).

paths.name: expo-image
paths.message: Import Image from @/components/image — className on raw expo-image is silently dropped on native (uniwind needs the withUniwind wrapper).

paths.name: react-native
paths.message: Use @/components/keyboard-avoiding-view (react-native-keyboard-controller) — core RN keyboard handling is inconsistent across platforms.

paths.name: react-native
paths.message: Use PresstableScale/PresstableOpacity from @/components/presstable (pressto) — presses are debounced there so a double-tap can't navigate twice.

paths.name: react-native-keyboard-controller
paths.message: Import KeyboardAvoidingView from @/components/keyboard-avoiding-view (or KeyboardAwareScrollView from @/components/keyboard-aware-scroll-view) — the raw components drop className on native (they need the withUniwind wrapper).

paths.name: react
paths.message: React Compiler handles memoization automatically — use plain values/functions instead. Opt out with 'use no memo' if absolutely necessary.

paths.name: react-native-reanimated
paths.message: Import AnimatedView from @/components/animated-view — className on raw Animated.* components is silently dropped on native (needs the withUniwind wrapper). Named imports (FadeOut, withTiming, …) are fine.

paths.name: expo-router/head
paths.message: Import Head from @/components/head — expo-router/head throws on iOS unless Handoff's `origin` is configured; the wrapper is web-only (docs/solutions/expo-router-head-ios-handoff.md).

paths.name: expo-web-browser
paths.message: Import openExternalUrl from @/lib/open-external-url — the wrapper picks in-app browser (native) vs new tab (web) so components never touch expo-web-browser/window directly.
